name: Eve
description: Woman living at the time before the Flood

points: Eve was the mother of all living before the fall, and Adam had children in the heavens.

note.label: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World

points: Cain did not build a metropolis for one wife and one child. There were many people around at this time, because Adam and Eve had many children, inside and outside of the Garden of Eden.

note.label: Nolan Wells: The Perpetual Hatred We Never Learned

points: Adam knew his wife; she conceived and bare Cain. These are the children they had when they were cast out of the garden; Cain, their firstborn that they had when they were cast out. I'm emphasizing that. And Eve said, I have gotten a man from the Lord.

And Cain knew his wife; and she conceived, and bare Enoch: and he builded a city. Obviously it was a bunch of people around at this time; Adam and Eve had children prior; that's where Cain got his wife from. Cain built the city, and that city was called Enoch.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: The serpent beguiled Eve through a different doctrine, and that is why the churches are filled with women, mama's boys and weak men: the same doctrine of Satan is in there.
But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve. The serpent is talking about Satan. As the spiritual demon Satan tricked Eve, our foremother.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

points: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ. As the serpent tricked Eve, through his trickery. So our minds should not be corrupted from the simplicity which is in Christ.

The serpent beguiled Eve; he tricked Eve, like he tricking these people in these Christian churches. These scriptures is so plain to be understood. Your mind should not be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

note.label: Awake and Return: Overcoming Babylon's Hypnosis

points: As the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so our minds were corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ. It is easy to understand Christ if you read for yourself.

note.label: Puerto Rico: The Flame Of Resistance

points: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted. The dictionary definition of subtle was read in class: pleasing to the senses in a mild or nuanced way. Satan will use that with the sisters: you get that little bit of power, I decide what we eat around here, I picked out the curtains, and it feels good; then you start overstepping your bounds and do not even know that was Satan setting you up. Sisters, when you start to overstep your divine place and purpose, recognize it.

note.label: Respect: The Evidence Of Her Faith

points: The serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty — his trickery, his cunning games — and he has done the same thing to us through his political system, his entertainment system and his religious system.

note.label: Black Christians Stuck in Delusional Orbiting Cycles of Stupidity
